needs_manual_review_reason: NEW RECORD (2026-07-17), resolving a second open thread flagged in sources/query_log.md's Checkpoint 2 triage note (GSE287174 never followed up, disposition undocumented). scripts/extract_gsm_characteristics.py's per-sample fallback found all 65 GSM records fall cleanly into two tissue values: 33 'Patient resected tumor' and 32 'Patient-derived tumor organoid'. Per docs/scope.md, organoid (in vitro model system) data is adjacent scope, not core, so this study was split into two records at the scope boundary: this one covers only the 33 patient-resected-tumor samples (genuine core-scope patient tissue); the matched 32-sample organoid arm is gse-287174-zohdy-meningioma-organoid-model.json in /data/adjacent/. Sample titles use a shared patient-number naming convention ('Patient resected tumor P2-1' / 'Patient-derived tumor organoid PO2-1') that let the two arms be confirmed as genuinely matched: both arms cover the exact same 7 patient numbers (2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9 -- patients 1 and 5 are absent from both arms, presumably excluded during the study's own QC), with every patient represented in both. paired_multimodal.is_paired is deliberately left false (not true) despite this genuine same-cohort match, matching this corpus's own established precedent on figshare-24217661-halder-mrm-tissue-proteomics/figshare-26620783-halder-mrm-serum-proteomics: multi_modal_matched requires >=2 different MODALITIES per docs/schema.md's own tag definition, and both arms here are bulk_rna_seq, the same modality, just different sample types (tissue vs. organoid model) -- so the cross-reference is carried in paired_multimodal.related_datasets alone, without flipping the multi_modal_matched tag. Publication (PMID 39941893, Cancers 2025, DOI 10.3390/cancers17030526, MDPI open access) verified via PubMed esummary and its own PMC full text (PMC11817449), confirmed citing GSE287174. Sole corresponding author (Tomas Garzon-Muvdi) confirmed via the full text's own author-notes correspondence footnote, matching the live GEO Series_contributor list. No per-sample grade/sex/age/brain-invasion/outcome data exists in the GSM metadata, so those fields correctly remain 'Not reported'. tissue_preservation set to 'fresh_frozen' per the paper's methods (fresh tissue used to both establish organoid cultures and for direct RNA-seq comparison).
